mapper.select: select product_id, product_code as id, product_name as name, category, spec, series, description, image_url as image, price_cent as price, original_price_cent as original_price, stock, sales, sort_num, status from biz_product where product_code = #{code} and status = '0'

select store_id, store_code as id, store_name as name, province, city, district, address, phone, latitude, longitude, open_hours as hours, image_url as image, service_qr, group_qr, sort_num, status from biz_store where status = '0' order by sort_num asc, store_id desc

select store_id, store_code as id, store_name as name, province, city, district, address, phone, latitude, longitude, open_hours as hours, image_url as image, service_qr, group_qr, sort_num, status from biz_store where store_code = #{code} and status = '0'

select coupon_template_id, template_code as id, template_name as name, coupon_type as kind, amount_cent as amount, discount_rate as rate, min_amount_cent as minimum, min_quantity, max_discount_cent as max_discount, member_only, points_only, channel, stock, claim_limit, start_time, end_time, sort_num, status from biz_coupon_template where status = '0' and (start_time is null or start_time <= now()) and (end_time is null or end_time >= now()) order by sort_num asc, coupon_template_id desc

select e.exchange_item_id, e.exchange_code as id, e.item_name as name, e.item_type as kind, t.template_code as template_id, e.spec, e.image_url as image, e.redeem_store_id, s.store_name as redeem_store_name, e.points, e.stock, e.per_user_limit, e.sort_num, e.status from biz_exchange_item e left join biz_coupon_template t on t.coupon_template_id = e.coupon_template_id left join biz_store s on s.store_id = e.redeem_store_id where e.status = '0' and e.stock <> 0 and (e.item_type <> 'coupon' or (t.coupon_template_id is not null and t.status = '0' and t.stock <> 0 and (t.start_time is null or t.start_time <= now()) and (t.end_time is null or t.end_time > now()))) and (e.item_type <> 'goods' or e.redeem_store_id is null or s.status = '0') order by e.sort_num asc, e.exchange_item_id desc
select config_key, config_value from biz_brand_config order by config_key
